help.title: Leads
help.overview: A lead is a job a client posted on the portal that matches one of your listings: the right category and, for on-site work, a place inside your service area. Send a quote with your price, or decline to pass.

sections.title: What you see
items: The job's category, city, budget, photos and how far it is from your listing.
The street, postcode and the client's contact are shown only when your quote is accepted.
Opening a new lead marks it viewed.

sections.title: Quote or decline
items: Quote: your price in the job's currency, the days you need and a short proposal. The client compares it with the other quotes.
Decline: you pass on the job; the client is not told.
A lead you quoted on, declined, won or lost takes no further answer.
